data: Binance spot 1-minute bars, 2020-01-01 to 2025-12-31 UTC. A = 2020-2024 (the direction comes from A), B = 2025 (every *_B number).
entry: A reading is known at its bar close; the measured entry is the open of the next minute.
rule: Per coin and horizon: the top event levels by oheat_B (windows per day x odds points on B) and by share_over_B (at least 0.2 windows per day). No pass mark is used as a filter. Names with identical samples and numbers are one row (aliases). batch10 = the ten hottest across the coins at that horizon, one row per coin and event (OR-HM1 Amendment 3 default batch).

units.share_B: % of events beyond the entry on the called side at the horizon
units.odds_B: points (half the shift in P(up) - P(down))
units.oheat_B: windows per day x odds points
units.dip_B: bps, usual move against the call before the best point
units.tick_B: the coin price step in bps

stamp: tables of run 43030435253; pack job 43057668061 at commit c6db27c7ea68c0d93fbabfe5f36b00921ad5cd72

live_reader_parity.note: The live reader (oracle.heat_live) on a window of bars against the engine on the whole history, on real minutes. live_parity False on a row = its indicator gave a different key on a window for at least one coin; such a row is in the tables but the live reader does not reproduce it exactly.
